author: Caldor
what_it_is: Chrono Trigger. New Game + save at the start of the game. Levels in the lower to mid 50s. Complete system file included.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 2 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); together they hold 2 save(s), 2 for this game (BASLUS-01363-00002, BASLUS-01363SYSTEM)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr PS3/EXPORT/PSV/BASLUS-013632D3030303032.PSV PS3/EXPORT/PSV/BASLUS-0136353595354454D.PSV: puts the save(s) on a freshly formatted card, as MemcardRex imports a single save
